Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Our burgeoning forestry industry has highlighted an opportunity. We should open a particle board factory. Here, we can use a lot of the traditional waste products and turn them into wood products that are only slightly not as good as the real thing! Can be upgraded for Wood Veneer Production.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Production has been strong, but the demand for our timber products has been stronger. Using this upgrade boosts industrial efficiency, and we can offer the same "high" quality wood products by shaving off the top grain and simply wrapping it around some sawdust.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: We have grain, way too much grain in fact. All our neighboring cities are starting to get upset about all the grain we're shipping them. Let's get in on the breakfast cereal game! We have more than enough grain to do it!
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Demand has been great, sales have been better, so good that we can't keep up! Expanding into our own logistics hub will give us the greater reach we've been needing. We can also use the extra room to open a new production line to offer our special Sugar-Blasted-Sugar-Bran Cereal.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Our livestock pens are at capacity, and the petting zoos just aren't bringing in the crowds like they used to.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: We're getting a lot of interest in our livestock from areas outside the city. Our best butchers have come up with a solution, we should just put it all on a truck, and send it to them. Genius!
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: A group of cottage industries have sprouted around our many vegetable farms. It seems that our local produce is delicious when infused with copious amounts of caffeine.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Our local energy drink has gained worldwide acclaim! Everyone loves it, and for some reason, can't stop drinking it, even if they wanted to. Let's set up a shipping department while we investigate that last claim.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Our town is starting to grow, don't you think it's time our fashion sense grew along with it?
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Sales are through the roof, and our city is dressed better than ever! But everywhere is just yoga pants and branded t-shirts.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Now that our oil industry is taking off, we just happened to notice that, when refined properly, we have the ability to launch things really high into the air. Refining that special formula is sure to boost our profits to new heights!
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: It's time to scale up! Our rocket fuel sales are booming, and now is the time to provide a solid boost.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Now that we've started pulling metals out of the ground, we'd better start doing something with them; the pile is starting to rust.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: We've all been enjoying the benefits of our metals in modern society, but we can still do better. Adding the Foundry will give us the workshop space needed to rapidly expand our production to meet the increasing demand.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: We're glad to see the city has adopted some more "business-friendly" policies. We're looking forward to doing great things together.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Hear me out, long tubes of metal, that's where the future is! We can wrap it around spools, stretch it out into long cables, we might even be able to use those long cables to make bridges!
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Our roads could use some resurfacing, and our buildings are all starting to lean a little bit. Setting up a Concrete Batch Plant would deliver small batches of concrete to exactly where they need to be to keep our town running.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack8-Industr: Our concrete operations around town have been attracting some attention. Expanding our operation to include ready-mixed concrete would expand our reach to service more of the city.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-IndustrialSigna: Regulators have been asking about what happens when the vehicles that are launched into the air using our fuels come back down, how do they not burn up in the atmosphere? Nanopolymers, that's how. They didn't ask for further elaboration.
Hear me out, pouring molten metal into a cast, that's where the future is! We can cast automobile parts, train parts, we can probably even do bicycle parts.
A major shortfall of doing the kind of work we do is burned hands. We've tried gloves, but they end up burning too. Fabricating some machinery would surely help our operation be successful.

We've been working on removing impurities from our concrete operations, and to our surprise, there happens to be quite a bit of minerals in the local stone. Separating those minerals and selling them to other industries could make a handsome sum of money.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-CommercialSigna: Due to the recently opened Particleboard Factory in town, the local market has been flooded with low-cost consumer-grade furniture; as a result, we have an abundance of older, sturdier furniture that can be sold at a premium to those that can pay.

Our Cereal Mill has been working overtime; it's time to turn our city into the sweetest place on Earth, literally! We already have the perfect building picked out that we can renovate and start selling our Convenience Foods.

Small business is the heart of our economy, and farmers are the foundation of our small businesses. Building a Farmers' Market will give our farmers a place to sell their all-natural, homegrown, farm-fresh foods.
Come on down to the Sportsbar and enjoy some sports, and grab a case of energy drinks to take home! Because, due to legal and insurance requirements, you can't actually drink our energy drinks here.
The good news? We have monumental demand for our athletic wear. The bad news? We have nowhere to sell it, especially not in the quantities we're expecting. Let's fix that!
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack8-OfficeSignature: We have a wealth of furniture, but are almost completely broke on ideas for where to put it all. Opening the Interior Design Studio will surely put us on the map for any lover of fine tables, chairs, and even smaller tables!

We've seen an increasing number of television stations becoming increasingly unwilling to participate in product placement during Saturday morning cartoons. Opening our own studio is certain to help keep that ad money flowing and cereal sales booming.
Our livestock industry has gained renown outside our city. We need a place to plan events and facilitate meetings between buyers and sellers.
A whole business office, all supporting our favorite local beverage. We have a museum devoted to the somewhat storied history of our energy drink. We have floors of sales offices. We have it all!
The great thing about looking good is looking good on camera. We need a place locally for our brand representatives to look good while showing everyone how good they look!
In collaboration with Chirp-X, we've designed a state-of-the-art control center to keep track of all the various things we've launched into orbit over the years.

This beautiful glass and steel tower is built from metals mined and smelted right here in our city. There is no better testament to our industry. Just watch out for the 25th floor; I've heard the city regulators aren't too happy up there.
Sometimes the wheels need to be greased to keep the machine working; well, here you can find the greasiest of wheels, ready and willing to help keep the machine working overtime.
Our explorative efforts have been hampered by not having a central headquarters to coordinate. Just the other day, we had a crew assigned to fill in a hole that another crew was assigned to dig.
